description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training set is divided among 13 labeled data sources, with labels and percentages displayed outside the slices and connected by leader lines (no separate legend is shown). The slices are: NQ in dark blue at about 31.3%; FEVER in teal at about 16.1%; SNLI in brown at about 15.4%; VITAMINC in blue‑green at about 13.0%; MULTNLI in muted red at about 11.3%; ANLI in orange at about 4.6%; FACTCC in yellow‑brown at about 2.6%; ENTFA in green at about 1.8%; XSUMHUL in light gray at about 1.6%; SCITAIL in olive/greenish at about 1.2%; PUBHEALTH in light green at about 0.5%; MULTIFC in light blue at about 0.5%; and SCIFACT in very light gray at about 0.1%. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
